title: CALPHAD-based transfer learning designs high-strength Al–Mg–Zn alloys
summary: A CALPHAD-informed transfer-learning and multi-objective optimization workflow selected two laboratory alloys. The abstract reports tensile strengths of 472 ± 7 MPa and 569 ± 12 MPa, with elongations of 23.5 ± 0.5% and 14.9 ± 0.3%. These are measured alloy properties, not industrial qualification.
ai_technology: CALPHAD-informed transfer learning; ensemble regression; NSGA-II
organization: Central South University; Changsha University of Science and Technology; China Three Gorges University

evidence.tested: The primary source reports the study-specific result summarized here.
evidence.unknown: Independent replication and broad deployment are not established by this review.
evidence.ai_role: A thermodynamics-informed representation transfers knowledge from established alloy systems; ML predictions and NSGA-II guide experiments, and selected alloys are synthesized and tested.
